title: Sea Turtle Retreat
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘Sea Turtle Retreat’ a Luxury 7 Bedroom, 7 Full & 2 Half Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 28 guests, this home offers a private pool, private beach access & 6-seater golf cart.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • 7 Bedrooms • 7 Full & 7 Full/2 Half Bathrooms • Sleeps 28 • Stunning Gulf Views • Private Beach Access • Private Heated Plunge Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $30 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) • 6-Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • Balcony Fire Pit Overlooking the Gulf • Gated Community • Parking for 4 vehicles DESCRIPTION: Welcome to ‘Sea Turtle Retreat’, a stunning three-story luxury vacation home located in the heart of Seagrove Beach. Situated within a gated community, this exquisite property offers breathtaking gulf views, private beach access, and vibrant, modern interiors designed to inspire relaxation and joy. Every detail of this retreat has been carefully curated to provide an unforgettable escape for families and friends alike. The first floor greets you with a spacious den featuring a wet bar, complete with a sink, mini fridge, and ice maker, making it the perfect spot for entertaining. This floor boasts a king guest suite with an ensuite bathroom, a fun and functional bunk room, a full bathroom, and an additional half bath. For added convenience, a large laundry room with double washers, dryers, and ample storage is also located on this level. The seamless indoor-outdoor connection leads directly to the pool deck, providing effortless access to the home’s private plunge pool and outdoor amenities. The second floor is designed for gathering and entertaining. The living room, centered around a cozy fireplace, flows effortlessly into the dining area with seating for ten and a chef’s dream kitchen. This state-of-the-art culinary space features top-of-the-line Wolf and Sub-Zero appliances, double ovens, a wine fridge, an ice machine, double dishwashers, and a wet bar. A balcony with outdoor seating extends from this space, offering spectacular gulf views. Two elegant king guest suites, each with private ensuite bathrooms, provide comfort and privacy for guests. A conveniently located half bathroom with custom wallpaper completes this level. On the third floor, you’ll find more luxury with a wet bar featuring a sink and mini fridge, along with an additional washer and dryer. A luxurious king guest suite offers expansive gulf views, while the primary suite elevates the experience with a beautifully appointed ensuite bathroom and access to a shared balcony. This gulf-view balcony, complete with a firepit, is the perfect setting for evening relaxation and stargazing. In addition to the third floor is a fun and cozy bunk room perfect for younger guests. The outdoor space at ‘Sea Turtle Retreat’ is an oasis of tranquility and entertainment. The private plunge pool is surrounded by a spacious deck, and the grilling station, complete with an ice machine and mini fridge, invites al fresco dining. An outdoor shower and a charming green space enhance the property’s appeal, while direct private beach access ensures a serene and exclusive coastal experience. From the modern, colorful interiors to the thoughtful amenities and spectacular views, ‘Sea Turtle Retreat’ offers a luxurious and unforgettable stay. Whether gathering on the balcony, preparing meals in the gourmet kitchen, or lounging by the pool, this Seagrove Beach gem is the perfect setting for creating lasting memories along 30A.
